doc: On-disk inverted index for FTS5. Lives entirely in shadow tables managed by the regular b-tree storage layer; this part owns the segment / doclist byte format embedded in t_data blobs and the iterators consumed by the query layer.

Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Live handle for a single FTS5 index. Wraps the open btree handles for t_data / t_idx / t_content / t_docsize / t_config and the cached structure record. Callers MUST treat as opaque; representation is target-private.

SegId.doc: Per-table segment identifier. Monotonically increasing across the lifetime of the index; reused only after the segment has merged out of every level.

StructureRecord.doc: Decoded form of t_data row id=10. Authoritative listing of every live segment.

DetailLevel.doc: Mirror of Fts5DetailLevel from the query part — duplicated here so the index can decode without depending on the query part.

Posting.doc: One unit yielded by Fts5PostingIter. col / pos absent under detail=column and detail=none.

Fts5PostingIter.doc: Iterator yielding postings for one term, prefix, or phrase. Yields rowids in ascending order. Ownership: borrows the Fts5IndexHandle for its lifetime.

Fts5PrefixIndexLengths.doc: List of prefix-index lengths configured for the table. Empty list = no prefix indexes.

Fts5SegmentLeafHeader.doc: On-disk segment-leaf framing. The cell-array of (term_record) follows; described in master.md prose because variable framing.

Fts5IndexCondition.doc: Closed set of failure conditions raised by this part.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: open
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Open an existing FTS5 index by table name. Reads t_config and the structure record into memory.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: create
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Provision the shadow tables for a new FTS5 index from a parsed config.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: insert_row
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Insert a row's tokenized content. column_streams is one tokenized stream per indexed column in declaration order.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: delete_row
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Tombstone a rowid. Errors with Fts5ContentlessDelete in contentless mode.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: posting_iter_term
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Open an iterator yielding postings for the exact term.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: posting_iter_prefix
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Open an iterator yielding postings for every term sharing the byte prefix.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: posting_iter_phrase
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Open an iterator yielding postings (rowid, col, first_pos) of adjacent occurrences of the token sequence in the same column. Errors under detail=none.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: row_dl
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Total token count for a row (sum across indexed columns). Returns 0 when columnsize=0.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: n_rows_with
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Number of rows whose doclist contains the given term. Used by IDF.

Fts5IndexHandle.name: integrity_check
Fts5IndexHandle.doc: Walk every segment, verify term ordering, doclist parses, structure-record consistency.

Fts5PostingIter.name: next
Fts5PostingIter.doc: Advance to the next posting. Returns absent when the stream is exhausted.

Fts5PostingIter.name: seek_rowid
Fts5PostingIter.doc: Skip forward to the smallest posting with rowid ≥ target. Used by AND-merge to skip large gaps.
